method: Use the deployed prebuilt MCP probe with its original Node process/input/file checks and a concurrent offline Python task holding 16 MiB and doing CPU work for six seconds. Sample Docker stats and host MemAvailable for twelve seconds. Require idle task capacity first; use synthetic task identities only. No service restart, image build, Dart compilation, credentials output or user-data modification.
limitation: Representative single-MCP plus code workload, not a multi-tenant stress test or proof that arbitrary plugin workloads fit. Runner peak includes the measurement helper. Existing resource limits were observed, not changed.
